unsupported_statements: "Only a handful of other departments have ever requested this resource." The facts give no data on how many other departments requested the resource. They only give 5 total requests and 1 from this department.
"low likelihood of denial" is an interpretation of the risk score percentile of 13. The facts don't say what the score means, or whether a low score means a low likelihood of denial.
"Approve with monitoring" is a decision the facts don't support. They contain no approval policy and no monitoring mechanism.
